individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A consists of flow cytometry scatter/density plots where each dot represents an individual cell event; these are not summary/average plots, so individual data points are inherently displayed.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars, means, or box/violin elements are present; these are gating plots with percentage labels only.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel B shows flow cytometry scatter plots for PC identification where each dot is an individual cell event, not a summary statistic.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars or averaged values with variance measures are shown; only gate percentages on raw event plots.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel C shows the MBC gating strategy as flow cytometry dot plots with individual cell events displayed, not an average summary plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars present; this is a gating strategy plot with percentage annotations only.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel D is a color-coded overlay scatter plot (MBC, GC, naive populations) where each dot represents an individual cell event.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars shown; this is a color-coded overlay of raw single-cell flow cytometry events.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel E shows MBC subset gating as flow cytometry dot plots with individual cell events displayed and gate percentages labeled.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars present; only gate percentage labels on raw flow cytometry events.
